from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
from factoryline.external_evidence import import_external_runtime_bundle, verify_external_runtime_receipt
root = Path('.')
artifact = root / 'runtime.txt'
artifact.write_text('green\n', encoding='utf-8')
bundle = root / 'bundle.json'
bundle.write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 'factory.external-runtime-bundle.v1', 'provider': 'testsprite', 'project_id': 'smoke-project', 'test_id': 'smoke-test', 'run_id': 'smoke-run', 'snapshot_id': 'smoke-snapshot', 'code_version': 'smoke-commit', 'environment': {'fingerprint': 'smoke-env', 'label': 'local'}, 'verdict': 'passed', 'failure_kind': 'none', 'first_failed_step': {'index': None, 'label': None}, 'hypothesis': '', 'recommended_fix': '', 'artifacts': [{'path': 'runtime.txt', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'kind': 'runtime-log'}], 'observed_at': '2026-08-24T12:00:00Z'}), encoding='utf-8')
result = import_external_runtime_bundle(root, bundle, 'testsprite')
verified = verify_external_runtime_receipt(root, root / result['path'])
assert result['marker'] == 'EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_IMPORTED' and verified['valid'] is True
